name: enterprise_rag_golden_set_v1
intended_use: Evaluate enterprise knowledge-base RAG retrieval, ranking, answer groundedness, refusal, prompt-injection robustness, Agent routing/planning/tool/trace behavior, and bounded adaptive evidence-loop trajectories.

fields.gold_sources: List of source document, section, and evidence string. Prefer source+section+evidence over chunk_id so the set remains stable after changing chunk size.
fields.must_include: Answer should include these semantic points.
fields.must_not_include: Answer should not contain these unsupported or incorrect claims.

agent_action_fields.expected_route: Expected deterministic route selected before planning.
agent_action_fields.expected_plan: Expected ordered production tool names for planning and execution-trace comparison.

agent_loop_fields.scenario: Expected adaptive trajectory: first-pass answer, rewrite-then-answer, rewrite-then-no-answer, or unsafe refusal.
agent_loop_fields.expected_tools: Expected ordered tools selected and executed by the bounded adaptive controller.
agent_loop_fields.expected_outcome: Expected final outcome after evidence assessment and bounded retry control.

warning: This dataset is synthetic and does not contain real company confidential information.
